b09.bersih: Bersihkan abu bersama warga, lalu dengarkan berita pagi

ember.1: Bak air di ujung jalan sudah ramai. Aku ambil ember, lalu serahkan ke Bu Sari.
ember.2: Airnya berat. Tangan sampai pergelangan basah.
ember.3: Ember berpindah tangan sampai tikungan. Tidak ada yang bicara, semua fokus ke abu.

a.1: Aku ikut estafet sampai ember terakhir. Badan jadi hangat.

b.1: Bu Sari hanya menggeleng. Katanya, biar nanti yang mengurus.

sapu.1: Sapu lidi menyapu abu tipis di aspal. Baunya masih baru.
sapu.2: Seorang bapak menyiram supaya abu tidak beterbangan. Air langsung jadi kelabu.

papan.1: Papan pengumuman balai desa. Jadwal ronda, kegiatan posyandu, satu kertas baru.
papan.2: Tiga titik lahan terbakar bulan ini. Tanggalnya rapat, arahnya selalu ke hutan.
papan.freq: Kertas baru itu ditulis tangan: 'Siaran radio balai desa: 104.5 FM. Info kebakaran tiap pagi.'
papan.3: Kalau ini cuma kebetulan, kenapa polanya rapi?

a.1: Aku foto kertasnya. Nanti kubandingkan dengan berita radio.

b.1: Mungkin memang musim kering. Tapi jariku tetap menulis tanggalnya.

radio.1: Berita pagi. Titik kebakaran lahan ketiga tercatat di kawasan hutan desa.
radio.2: Warga diimbau tidak membuka lahan dengan membakar. Api sulit dikendalikan.
radio.3: Tiga kali dalam sebulan. Hampir jam yang sama.
radio.4: Tanggalnya kucatat di jurnal, biar tidak lupa.

siap.1: Radio menyala, tapi yang keluar hanya desis. Jarinya melompat antar frekuensi.
siap.2: Di pengumuman papan tadi tertulis 104.5. Kutarik jarinya pelan-pelan.

p1.title: Radio Warung
p1.desc: Siaran pagi tersembunyi di balik derik frekuensi. Putar ke angka yang benar.
p1.hint1: Frekuensi siaran desa tertulis di kertas papan pengumuman.

sepatu.1: Di teras, sepatu kerja Abang berdiri berjajar. Solnya penuh tanah liat.
sepatu.2: Tanahnya masih basah. Baunya asap dan lumpur.
sepatu.3: Semalam dia bilang kerja sampai malam. Tanah ini bukan dari proyek.

pulang.1: Jalan mulai ramai. Aku pulang dulu, jurnal harus diisi sebelum lupa.
pulang.2: Tiga tanggal, satu arah. Nanti aku tanya Abang pelan-pelan.

b09.bersih: Clear the ash with the villagers, then listen to the morning news
b09.pola: Record the fire pattern in the journal

ember.1: The tank at the end of the road is already crowded. I take a bucket and hand it to Bu Sari.
ember.2: The water is heavy. My hands are wet to the wrists.
ember.3: The bucket changes hands down to the corner. No one speaks, all eyes on the ash.

a.1: I keep passing buckets until the last one. My body warms up.

b.1: Bu Sari only shakes her head. She says those in charge will come later.

sapu.1: A palm fibre broom sweeps thin ash from the asphalt. The smell is still fresh.
sapu.2: A man pours water so the ash will not fly. The water turns grey at once.

papan.1: The village hall notice board. Patrol roster, health clinic schedule, one new sheet.
papan.2: Three burned plots this month. The dates sit close together, always pointing at the forest.
papan.freq: That new sheet, handwritten: 'Village hall radio: 104.5 FM. Fire updates every morning.'
papan.3: If this is only coincidence, why is the pattern so neat?

a.1: I photograph the sheet. Later I will compare it with the radio news.

b.1: Maybe it really is the dry season. But my hand still writes the dates down.

radio.1: Morning news. The third land fire point is recorded near the village forest.
radio.2: Residents are urged not to clear land by burning. Fire is hard to control.
radio.3: Three times in a month. Almost the same hour.
radio.4: I write the dates in my journal so I do not forget.

siap.1: The radio comes on, but only static comes out. Its needle jumps between frequencies.
siap.2: The notice board said 104.5. I ease the needle across, slowly.

p1.title: Warung Radio
p1.desc: The morning broadcast hides behind the static. Turn the dial to the right numbers.
p1.hint1: The village frequency is written on the sheet at the notice board.
p1.hint2: 104.5 FM. Four digits without a dot: 1045.

sepatu.1: On the porch, Abang's work boots stand in a row. The soles are caked with clay.
sepatu.2: The soil is still wet. It smells of smoke and mud.
sepatu.3: Last night he said he worked late. This soil is not from the construction site.

pulang.1: The road is filling up. I head home, the journal has to be written before I forget.
pulang.2: Three dates, one direction. Later I will ask Abang, gently.
